copy.blurb: The Market's line on Morocco versus Haiti is already sitting where the model would put it, to within a point on every side. A market this efficient is doing its job: the available information is priced, and there's no slow-moving line for the engine to catch. The model's three-way read — Morocco at 80%, the draw at 10%, Haiti at 10% — tracks the market's shape closely enough that the difference is noise, not edge. Pass is the right call when the price has nothing left to give away. The interesting fixtures are the ones where the line lags; today, this is not one of them.
